["function", "core_assistant", "check_agent_binding", "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core_assistant.check_agent_binding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE turn_key TEXT; conversation TEXT; t RECORD; spent NUMERIC; round_count BIGINT;
BEGIN
 IF TG_TABLE_NAME='agent_turns' THEN turn_key:=NEW.id;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='requests' THEN
  IF NEW.assistant_grant_id IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  SELECT turn_id INTO turn_key FROM core_assistant.agent_rounds WHERE model_request_id=NEW.id;
 ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='agent_tool_observations' THEN
  SELECT turn_id INTO turn_key FROM core_assistant.agent_tool_operations WHERE id=NEW.operation_id;
 ELSE turn_key:=NEW.turn_id; END IF;
 IF turn_key IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
 IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') NOT IN ('read committed','serializable') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'agent writes require read committed or serializable isolation' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT conversation_id INTO STRICT conversation FROM core_assistant.agent_turns WHERE id=turn_key;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(conversation,908534117));
 SELECT * INTO STRICT t FROM core_assistant.agent_turns WHERE id=turn_key FOR NO KEY UPDATE;
 IF t.phase IN ('new','model_running','tools_pending','unknown') AND EXISTS(
  SELECT FROM core_charging.requests q JOIN core_assistant.grants g ON g.id=q.assistant_grant_id
  WHERE g.conversation_id=t.conversation_id AND q.state NOT IN ('settled','released')
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM core_assistant.agent_rounds r WHERE r.model_request_id=q.id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'agent and legacy admission conflict' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(t.host_policy->'allowed_tools') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR
 jsonb_typeof(t.host_policy->'model') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR
 jsonb_typeof(t.host_policy->'max_rounds') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR
 jsonb_typeof(t.host_policy->'budget_credits') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR
 jsonb_typeof(t.host_policy->'max_tool_calls') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' OR
 (t.host_policy->>'max_rounds')::integer IS DISTINCT FROM t.max_rounds OR
 (t.host_policy->>'budget_credits')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM t.budget_credits OR
 (t.host_policy->>'max_tool_calls')::integer NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 256 OR
 t.text_sha256<>sha256(convert_to(t.original_text,'UTF8')) OR
 ((t.host_policy->'allowed_tools') @> t.loaded_tools) IS NOT TRUE OR
 (t.host_policy->>'max_rounds')::integer<>t.max_rounds OR
 (t.host_policy->>'budget_credits')::bigint<>t.budget_credits OR
 NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM core_assistant.conversations v JOIN core_identity.credentials c ON c.id=t.session_id
  WHERE v.id=t.conversation_id AND v.owner_user_id=t.owner_user_id AND v.owner_account_id=t.owner_account_id
   AND c.kind='session' AND c.user_id=t.owner_user_id AND c.owner_account_id=t.owner_account_id AND c.user_version=t.auth_version) OR
 (SELECT sid FROM core_identity.web_session_credentials WHERE credential_id=t.session_id) IS DISTINCT FROM t.source_web_session_sid OR
 (t.source_web_session_sid IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM core_identity.web_sessions w WHERE w.sid=t.source_web_session_sid AND w.user_id=t.owner_user_id)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'agent original authority binding' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 SELECT count(*),coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN q.state='settled' THEN q.settled
  WHEN q.state IN ('reserved','streaming','reconcile') THEN q.reserved ELSE 0 END),0)
 INTO round_count,spent FROM core_assistant.agent_rounds r JOIN core_charging.requests q ON q.id=r.model_request_id WHERE r.turn_id=t.id;
 IF round_count>t.max_rounds OR spent>t.budget_credits OR spent<0 OR
 (SELECT count(*) FROM core_assistant.agent_rounds WHERE turn_id=t.id AND state IN ('prepared','streaming','unknown'))>1 OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM core_assistant.agent_rounds later JOIN core_assistant.agent_tool_operations earlier ON earlier.turn_id=later.turn_id
  JOIN core_assistant.agent_rounds prior ON prior.id=earlier.round_id WHERE later.turn_id=t.id AND prior.round<later.round AND earlier.state IN ('pending','claimed','unknown')) OR
 EXISTS(SELECT FROM core_assistant.agent_rounds r
  JOIN core_charging.requests q ON q.id=r.model_request_id
  LEFT JOIN core_assistant.grants g ON g.id=q.assistant_grant_id
  LEFT JOIN core_assistant.operations o ON o.request_id=q.id
  WHERE r.turn_id=t.id AND (r.round>=t.max_rounds OR
   g.id IS NULL OR o.grant_id IS DISTINCT FROM g.id OR
   g.conversation_id<>t.conversation_id OR g.turn_id<>('agent-'||t.id||'-'||r.round::text) OR
   g.session_id<>t.session_id OR g.auth_version<>t.auth_version OR
   g.policy IS DISTINCT FROM t.host_policy->'model' OR g.price IS DISTINCT FROM t.price OR q.price IS DISTINCT FROM t.price OR
   q.actor_user_id<>t.owner_user_id OR q.owner_account_id<>t.owner_account_id OR
   o.text<>t.original_text OR o.text_sha256<>t.text_sha256 OR
   r.context_sha256<>sha256(r.context_json) OR
   (r.provider_response_json IS NOT NULL AND r.provider_response_sha256<>sha256(r.provider_response_json)) OR
   NOT ((r.state='streaming' AND q.state IN ('streaming','reconcile')) OR (r.state='settled' AND q.state='settled') OR
        (r.state='unknown' AND q.state='reconcile') OR (r.state='released' AND q.state='released')))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'agent original model grant or parent budget binding' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM core_assistant.agent_tool_operations o JOIN core_assistant.agent_rounds r ON r.id=o.round_id JOIN core_charging.requests q ON q.id=r.model_request_id
  WHERE o.turn_id=t.id AND (r.state<>'settled' OR q.state<>'settled' OR q.outcome IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed' OR r.provider_response_sha256 IS NULL OR
   o.arguments_sha256<>sha256(o.arguments_json) OR
   ((t.host_policy->'allowed_tools') ? o.tool_name) IS NOT TRUE OR
   (o.result_json IS NOT NULL AND o.result_sha256<>sha256(o.result_json)) OR
   NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM jsonb_array_elements(convert_from(r.provider_response_json,'UTF8')::jsonb #> '{choices,0,message,tool_calls}') call
    WHERE call->>'id'=o.provider_call_id AND call#>>'{function,name}'=o.tool_name
      AND convert_to(call#>>'{function,arguments}','UTF8')=o.arguments_json))) OR
 (SELECT count(*) FROM core_assistant.agent_tool_operations WHERE turn_id=t.id)>(t.host_policy->>'max_tool_calls')::integer THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'agent tool provider provenance binding' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF t.phase='completed' AND (EXISTS(SELECT FROM core_assistant.agent_rounds WHERE turn_id=t.id AND state NOT IN ('settled','released'))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT FROM core_assistant.agent_tool_operations WHERE turn_id=t.id AND state IN ('pending','claimed','unknown'))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'agent completed with unresolved effects' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM core_assistant.agent_tool_observations b JOIN core_assistant.agent_tool_operations o ON o.id=b.operation_id
  WHERE o.turn_id=t.id AND (b.claim_key IS DISTINCT FROM o.claim_key OR (b.state='completed' AND
   (o.state<>'completed' OR b.result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM o.result_sha256 OR b.domain_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM o.domain_receipt_id)))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'agent original claim observation binding' USING ERRCODE='23514';
 END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$
"]

["function", "core_billing", "import_legacy_pending_liability", "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core_billing.import_legacy_pending_liability(p_request jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    migration TEXT := p_request->>'migration_id';
    source_table_name TEXT := p_request->>'source_table';
    source_key TEXT := p_request->>'source_row_key';
    prior core_billing.legacy_pending_liabilities%ROWTYPE;
    result JSONB;
BEGIN
    IF current_user <> pg_get_userbyid((SELECT nspowner FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname='core_billing')) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'pending liability imports require the offline schema owner' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
    IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') <> 'serializable' OR current_setting('synchronous_commit') <> 'on' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'pending liability imports require serializable durable commit' USING ERRCODE='25001';
    END IF;
    IF NOT COALESCE(
        jsonb_typeof(p_request)='object'
        AND (SELECT array_agg(k ORDER BY k) FROM jsonb_object_keys(p_request) k) = ARRAY[
            'amount_raw_json','currency_raw_json','mapping_sha256','migration_id','observed_at',
            'owner_account_id','owner_user_id','payload_json','request','result','settlement_state',
            'source_archive_sha256','source_parent_plan_sha256','source_row_key','source_row_sha256',
            'source_table','spendable','spendable_units','status']::TEXT[]
        AND migration ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{1,128}$'
        AND source_table_name ~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}$'
        AND source_key ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:/-]{1,200}$'
        AND p_request->>'source_archive_sha256' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        AND p_request->>'mapping_sha256' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        AND p_request->>'source_row_sha256' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        AND (p_request->>'source_parent_plan_sha256' IS NULL OR p_request->>'source_parent_plan_sha256' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
        AND (p_request->>'owner_user_id')::BIGINT > 0
        AND (p_request->>'owner_account_id')::BIGINT > 0
        AND p_request->>'status' IN ('pending','unknown','unpaid','failed','canceled','succeeded','refunded','manual_review')
        AND p_request->>'settlement_state' IN ('unknown','unresolved','terminal_no_payment','terminal_paid','manual_review')
        AND p_request->>'spendable' = 'false'
        AND (p_request->>'spendable_units')::BIGINT = 0
        AND (p_request->>'observed_at')::BIGINT BETWEEN -62135596800 AND 253402300799
        AND jsonb_typeof(p_request->'payload_json') IN ('object','array','string','number','boolean','null')
        AND jsonb_typeof(p_request->'amount_raw_json') IN ('object','array','string','number','boolean','null')
        AND jsonb_typeof(p_request->'currency_raw_json') IN ('object','array','string','number','boolean','null')
        AND jsonb_typeof(p_request->'request')='object'
        AND jsonb_typeof(p_request->'result')='object', FALSE) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid pending liability import' USING ERRCODE='P1000';
    END IF;
    SELECT * INTO prior FROM core_billing.legacy_pending_liabilities
        WHERE migration_id=migration AND source_table=source_table_name AND source_row_key=source_key;
    IF FOUND THEN
        IF prior.request IS DISTINCT FROM p_request THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'pending liability identity has different parameters' USING ERRCODE='P1001';
        END IF;
        RETURN prior.result;
    END IF;
    result := jsonb_build_object('status','imported','migration_id',migration,'source_table',source_table_name,
        'source_row_key',source_key,'spendable',FALSE,'spendable_units',0);
    INSERT INTO core_billing.legacy_pending_liabilities(
        migration_id,source_archive_sha256,mapping_sha256,source_table,source_row_key,
        source_row_sha256,source_parent_plan_sha256,owner_user_id,owner_account_id,status,
        settlement_state,payload_json,amount_raw_json,currency_raw_json,spendable_units,
        spendable,observed_at,request,result)
    VALUES(
        migration,p_request->>'source_archive_sha256',p_request->>'mapping_sha256',source_table_name,source_key,
        p_request->>'source_row_sha256',NULLIF(p_request->>'source_parent_plan_sha256',''),
        (p_request->>'owner_user_id')::BIGINT,(p_request->>'owner_account_id')::BIGINT,p_request->>'status',
        p_request->>'settlement_state',p_request->'payload_json',p_request->'amount_raw_json',p_request->'currency_raw_json',
        (p_request->>'spendable_units')::BIGINT,FALSE,(p_request->>'observed_at')::BIGINT,
        p_request,result);
    RETURN result;
EXCEPTION WHEN unique_violation THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'retry complete pending liability transaction with original key' USING ERRCODE='40001';
END $function$
"]

["function", "core_charging", "guard_request", "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core_charging.guard_request()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF (NEW.id, NEW.actor_user_id, NEW.key_id, NEW.oauth_source, NEW.assistant_grant_id, NEW.assistant_sponsor_account_id, NEW.image_operation_id, NEW.owner_account_id, NEW.payer_account_id,

        IS DISTINCT FROM
       (OLD.id, OLD.actor_user_id, OLD.key_id, OLD.oauth_source, OLD.assistant_grant_id, OLD.assistant_sponsor_account_id, OLD.image_operation_id, OLD.owner_account_id, OLD.payer_account_id,
        OLD.fingerprint, OLD.worker_digest, OLD.spec_digest, OLD.price, OLD.source_subscription_id,
        OLD.source_start, OLD.source_end, OLD.authorized_at, OLD.hard_deadline)
       OR NEW.reserved < OLD.reserved OR NEW.refunded < OLD.refunded
       OR NEW.input_tokens < OLD.input_tokens OR NEW.cached_tokens < OLD.cached_tokens
       OR NEW.output_tokens < OLD.output_tokens OR NEW.revision <> OLD.revision + 1
       OR (OLD.image_usage IS NOT NULL AND NEW.image_usage IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.image_usage) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid charging mutation' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    -- Stored generated OAuth projections are NULL in NEW during BEFORE UPDATE.
    -- Their immutable source is checked above; compare every remaining mutable
    -- business column explicitly so a legitimate terminal refund stays possible.
    IF OLD.state IN ('settled', 'released') AND
        (NEW.state, NEW.reserved, NEW.lease_until, NEW.input_tokens, NEW.cached_tokens,
         NEW.output_tokens, NEW.image_usage, NEW.settled, NEW.outcome) IS DISTINCT FROM
        (OLD.state, OLD.reserved, OLD.lease_until, OLD.input_tokens, OLD.cached_tokens,
         OLD.output_tokens, OLD.image_usage, OLD.settled, OLD.outcome) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'request is terminal' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    IF NEW.state <> OLD.state AND NOT
       ((OLD.state = 'reserved' AND NEW.state IN ('streaming', 'released'))
        OR (OLD.state = 'streaming' AND NEW.state IN ('settled', 'reconcile'))
        OR (OLD.state = 'reconcile' AND NEW.state = 'settled')) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid charging transition' USING ERRCODE = '23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$
"]

["function", "core_charging", "subscription_window", "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core_charging.subscription_window(p_id bigint, p_at bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(start_at bigint, end_at bigint, limit_credits bigint, unlimited boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
    SELECT CASE WHEN o.subscription_id IS NOT NULL AND p_at < o.end_at THEN o.start_at ELSE w.start_at END,
           least(CASE WHEN o.subscription_id IS NOT NULL AND p_at < o.end_at THEN o.end_at ELSE w.end_at END,s.ends_at),
           CASE WHEN o.subscription_id IS NOT NULL AND p_at >= o.end_at AND s.reset_basis='explicit'
                THEN s.reset_limit_credits ELSE s.limit_credits END,
           CASE WHEN o.subscription_id IS NOT NULL AND p_at >= o.end_at AND s.reset_basis='explicit'
                THEN s.reset_unlimited ELSE s.unlimited END
    FROM core_charging.subscriptions s
    LEFT JOIN core_charging.subscription_opening_consumption o ON o.subscription_id=s.id
    -- A never-reset grant has one window for its entire lifetime, even when
    -- longer than the maximum duration allowed for a repeating custom period.
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL core_charging.period_window(
        CASE WHEN s.period='grant' THEN 'custom' ELSE s.period END,
        CASE WHEN s.period='custom' AND o.subscription_id IS NOT NULL AND p_at >= o.end_at
             THEN o.end_at ELSE s.anchor END,
        CASE WHEN s.period='grant' THEN s.ends_at-s.anchor ELSE s.seconds END,p_at) w
    WHERE s.id=p_id AND p_at>=s.anchor AND p_at<s.ends_at
      AND (o.subscription_id IS NULL OR p_at>=o.start_at)
      AND (s.reset_basis='same' OR o.subscription_id IS NOT NULL)
$function$
"]

 END IF;
END $function$
"]

["view", "core_history", "finance_native_payments", " WITH integrity AS (
         SELECT NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM pg_sequence q
                  WHERE q.seqrelid = 'core_payments.intents_id_seq'::regclass::oid AND (q.seqincrement <> 1 OR q.seqcycle))) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM core_payments.accepted_proofs p
                     JOIN core_payments.intents i ON i.id = p.intent_id
                  WHERE i.credit_journal_id IS NULL AND ((p.verified_facts ->> 'kind'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['Credit'::text, 'RefundSucceeded'::text])))) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM core_payments.accepted_proofs p
                     JOIN core_payments.intents i ON i.id = p.intent_id
                     LEFT JOIN core_payments.provider_refunds r ON r.channel_id = p.channel_id AND r.refund_id = (p.verified_facts ->> 'refund_id'::text)
                  WHERE i.credit_journal_id IS NOT NULL AND (p.verified_facts ->> 'kind'::text) = 'RefundSucceeded'::text AND (r.refund_id IS NULL OR r.intent_id <> i.id OR r.amount_minor::text <> (p.verified_facts ->> 'amount_minor'::text)))) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM core_payments.intents i
                  WHERE i.credit_journal_id IS NOT NULL AND i.refunded_minor::numeric <> (( SELECT COALESCE(sum(r.amount_minor::numeric), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                           FROM core_payments.provider_refunds r
                          WHERE r.intent_id = i.id)))) AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM core_history.finance_sources s
                     CROSS JOIN core_payments.intents i
                  WHERE i.credit_journal_id IS NOT NULL AND i.id <= s.native_intent_floor)) AS complete
        ), totals AS (
         SELECT intents.currency,
            sum(intents.amount_minor::numeric * 10000::numeric) AS gross_amount_micros,
            sum(intents.refunded_minor::numeric * 10000::numeric) AS refunded_amount_micros,
            count(*) AS orders
           FROM core_payments.intents
          WHERE intents.credit_journal_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY intents.currency
        )
 SELECT t.currency,
    t.gross_amount_micros,
    t.refunded_amount_micros,
    t.orders,
    c.complete
   FROM integrity c
     LEFT JOIN totals t ON true;", ["security_barrier=true"]]
